summary: 在位十三年，拒诸葛亮北伐、平辽东公孙渊，然大兴宫室，托孤曹爽司马懿，开高平陵之变伏线。
summary_en: In thirteen years he repelled Zhuge Liang's northern expeditions and subdued Gongsun Yuan in Liaodong, yet built palaces on a grand scale and entrusted his heir to Cao Shuang and Sima Yi, laying the fuse of the Gaopingling incident.

portrait.appearance_basis: 史载「天姿秀出」。画像宜表现沈毅好断的壮年君主之态，衣冠从曹魏中制。属艺术想象。

timeline.title: 生
timeline.summary: 文帝子，母甄氏；幼有岐嶷之姿。
timeline.summary_en: Son of Emperor Wen by Lady Zhen; marked from childhood for unusual promise.

timeline.title: 即位
timeline.summary: 文帝崩，叡即皇帝位，改元太和。
timeline.summary_en: On Emperor Wen's death, Rui took the throne and changed the era to Taihe.

timeline.title: 街亭与诸葛亮北伐
timeline.summary: 诸葛亮首出祁山，张郃破马谡于街亭，蜀军退还。
timeline.summary_en: In Zhuge Liang's first expedition from Qishan, Zhang He broke Ma Su at Jieting, and the Shu army withdrew.

timeline.title: 曹真伐蜀无功
timeline.title_en: Cao Zhen's Fruitless Invasion of Shu
timeline.summary: 曹真等大举伐蜀，会霖雨路断而还，无功。
timeline.summary_en: Cao Zhen's great invasion of Shu met weeks of rain, the roads collapsed, and the army returned without result.

timeline.title: 司马懿拒蜀
timeline.summary: 诸葛亮四出祁山，司马懿坚壁不出，蜀粮尽退。
timeline.summary_en: Zhuge Liang came a fourth time from Qishan; Sima Yi refused battle behind his walls until Shu ran out of grain and withdrew.

timeline.title: 诸葛亮卒于渭南
timeline.title_en: Zhuge Liang Dies at the Weinan
timeline.summary: 诸葛亮屯五丈原，与懿相持百馀日，病卒军中，蜀退。
timeline.summary_en: Zhuge Liang camped on the Wuzhang Plain and faced Sima Yi for over a hundred days before dying of illness in camp; Shu withdrew.

timeline.title: 张掖柳谷口瑞石
timeline.title_en: The Portent Stone at Liugu Pass
timeline.summary: 张掖柳谷口出瑞石，群臣奏符瑞，帝受之。
timeline.summary_en: A stone of good omen appeared at Liugu Pass in Zhangye; the courtiers offered it as a portent, and the emperor accepted it.

timeline.date_note_en: 5th year of Qinglong, era changed in the 3rd month
timeline.title: 改元景初
timeline.summary: 以青龙纪年不合历象，改元景初，建丑为正月。
timeline.summary_en: Deeming the Qinglong count out of step with the calendar, he changed the era to Jingchu and made the 12th month the first of the year.

timeline.title: 大营宫室
timeline.summary: 起洛阳宫、昭阳殿、太极殿，役民数万，谏者多被诛。
timeline.summary_en: He raised the Luoyang Palace, the Zhaoyang and Taiji halls, driving tens of thousands to labor, and put many remonstrants to death.

timeline.title: 司马懿平辽东
timeline.summary: 司马懿攻襄平，斩公孙渊，辽东悉平，魏地至朝鲜边境。
timeline.summary_en: Sima Yi stormed Xiangping, beheaded Gongsun Yuan, and pacified all Liaodong, carrying Wei's bounds to the Korean frontier.

timeline.title: 明帝崩托孤
timeline.summary: 疾笃立养子齐王芳为嗣，托孤曹爽、司马懿，寻崩。
timeline.summary_en: Mortally ill, he made his adopted son, Cao Fang of Qi, heir and entrusted him to Cao Shuang and Sima Yi, then died.

timeline.title: 毅然 果断
timeline.summary: 陈寿评明帝沈毅好断、任意不恤下人，能奋其威明而不尽礼于太后。
timeline.summary_en: Chen Shou judged the emperor resolute and self-assured, heedless of others beneath him — able to display his stern brilliance yet wanting in duty to the empress dowager.

relations.note_en: In the 7th year of Huangchu, Emperor Wen dies; Crown Prince Rui takes the throne

relations.note: 景初三年崩，养子芳即位
relations.note_en: Dies in Jingchu 3; his adopted son Fang takes the throne

bio_md:
# 魏明帝 · 主要事迹

曹叡字元仲，文帝子，母甄氏，幼有岐嶷之姿。黄初七年文帝崩，叡即皇帝位，年二十二。其治之要，在拒敌于西陲、平乱于辽东：太和二年诸葛亮首出祁山，张郃破马谡于街亭；其后亮屡出无功，青龙二年屯五丈原，与司马懿相持百馀日，病卒军中——蜀之北伐，至此而衰。景初二年司马懿率军四万攻辽东，破襄平，斩公孙渊，魏境遂至朝鲜边界。

明帝之失，在大营宫室：起洛阳宫、昭阳殿、太极殿，役民数万，群臣谏者多遭诛戮。改元景初、亲定历法，亦见其好断自任。陈寿评其「沈毅好断，任意不恤下人，故能奋其威明」，然「不能尽礼于太后，慎终追远」之讥，亦不可免。

景初三年正月，明帝疾笃，急召司马懿于辽东，执其手立养子曹芳为嗣，托孤于曹爽、司马懿，寻崩，年三十六。十年之后，高平陵之变起，曹氏之权尽归司马氏——明帝之托孤，实为曹魏存亡之枢机：任懿以平辽拒蜀，则功在社稷；托孤于懿，则祸胎后嗣。功过相权，后世论者每致慨焉。

> 参考：点校本《三国志》卷003《明帝纪》、卷035《诸葛亮传》。

bio_parts_en.value:
Cao Rui, styled Yuanzhong, son of Emperor Wen by Lady Zhen, showed unusual promise from childhood. On Emperor Wen's death in the 7th year of Huangchu he took the throne at twenty-two. His reign was defined by holding the west and pacifying the northeast: in the 2nd year of Taihe (228), in Zhuge Liang's first northern expedition, Zhang He broke Ma Su at Jieting; the later expeditions gained nothing, and in the 2nd year of Qinglong Liang camped on the Wuzhang Plain, faced Sima Yi for over a hundred days, and died of illness in camp — the Shu offensive never recovered. In the 2nd year of Jingchu Sima Yi marched forty thousand men on Liaodong, stormed Xiangping, beheaded Gongsun Yuan, and carried Wei's border to the Korean frontier.

Ming's failing was the great palace works: the Luoyang Palace and the Zhaoyang and Taiji halls rose on tens of thousands of laborers while remonstrants were put to death. His changes of era and calendar showed the same self-willed decisiveness. Chen Shou's verdict — "resolute and self-assured, heedless of those beneath him, able to display his stern brilliance" — concedes his power while noting his want of duty to the empress dowager.

In the first month of the 3rd year of Jingchu, mortally ill, he summoned Sima Yi from Liaodong, took his hand, named his adopted son Cao Fang heir, and entrusted him to Cao Shuang and Sima Yi; he died at thirty-six. Ten years later came the Gaopingling incident, and Wei's power passed wholly to the Simas. His regency trust was the hinge of Wei's fate: Sima Yi, the man who won Liaodong and held Zhuge Liang at bay, was the same man whose house would take the realm.

> References: the punctuated critical edition of the *Sanguozhi*, ch. 3 ("Benji of Emperor Ming"), ch. 35 (biography of Zhuge Liang).
